prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a high-fidelity cinematic web interface art-direction presentation for an existing Portuguese academic Green Lantern Corps incident-management ERP, OANET / Central de Oa. This is a visual design concept, not a coded application. User explicitly wants maximal cinematic immersion, close to reference images: pitch-black emerald military science fiction HUD, bright green power-ring energy, monumental alien architecture, angular precision-cut frames, holographic galaxy imagery.
Deliver ONE large landscape design board, approximately 16:10, three beautifully composed screen mockups: dominant desktop command dashboard across the top taking 65% of board; two smaller but clearly readable screens below, public home and incident detail. No device bezels. Clearly label each screen in the board margin.
Dashboard: 190px left sidebar featuring large luminous Green Lantern emblem and OANET wordmark; actual navigation ONLY: Visão geral, Ocorrências, Lanternas, Voltar ao portal. Header with Central de Oa, Setor 2814, user identity, small green online dot. Main bold page heading 'Central de Comando', supporting text 'O universo sob sua proteção.' Primary green action 'Registrar ocorrência'. Main visual is a cinematic overhead galactic sector map, with sharp green orbital lines, luminous stars and one selected Sector 2814; adjacent operational priority list. Bottom area is a clear compact real table of incidents with column headings Ocorrência, Setor, Gravidade, Status, statuses as text and small indicators; fictional sample row labels 'Distúrbio em Coast City', 'Sinal desconhecido', 'Patrulha de reconhecimento'; mark board margin 'Dados ilustrativos'. Do not fabricate energy/mission statistics or add unavailable equipment/report/messaging pages. Limit visual widgets so the dashboard feels directed, not crowded with tiny cards.
Home screen: magnificent cinematic panoramic Oa capital in deep space, green Central Power Battery rising from an alien city, strong editorial but technical heading 'A vontade protege o universo.' solid ivory/green type, CTA 'Entrar na Central', Green Lantern insignia, navigation Início, Lanternas, Sobre, Entrar.
Incident detail screen: heading 'Distúrbio em Coast City', readable description area, status 'Em atendimento', orange severity 'Alta', sector 2814, assignee identity portrait, clean action 'Atualizar status', cinematic vertical sector art on one side.
Art direction: unusually polished high-budget movie production terminal, environmental realism in image zones; near-black emerald matte work surfaces; luminous green ONLY in key cuts of frame and emissive assets, quieter hairline outlines elsewhere; precise chamfered corners, authentic Green Lantern emblem, emerald rings, faint technical coordinates confined to artwork. No generic white SaaS surfaces. Elegant condensed heading font with humanist readable body font. Primary text off-white. Amber/red reserved for warnings. Keep actual form/table backgrounds solid and legible. Borders are fine technical edges, no thick accent sidebars, no soft floating card shadows, no excessive rounded cards, no gradient-filled text. No wallpaper behind all small text. Crisp designed typography with generous readable sizes. All UI copy in Brazilian Portuguese. Cohesive art identity across the three mockups, sophisticated hierarchy, no watermarks.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity cinematic website design presentation board. Create ONE large landscape board approximately 3:2 containing SIX distinct evenly arranged web app screenshot concepts in a 3-column by 2-row arrangement, no hardware mockups. Screen labels in the outer margin. Shared design is OANET, Central de Oa, a Portuguese Green Lantern Corps academic ERP. MAXIMAL CINEMATIC green-energy alien control room aesthetic: black emerald solid surfaces, luminous authentic Green Lantern insignia, precision chamfered fine frames, cinematic realistic Oa architecture, galaxy backdrops used as side visuals, bright off-white legible body text, strong condensed headings, consistent emerald primary buttons with dark lettering, comfortable coherent controls. Avoid neon behind input text, tiny decorative gibberish, repeated metric cards, rounded SaaS cards and bright inactive icons. Do not include character portraits; represent personnel with monograms and insignias.

SIX screen designs, each fills its tile, text in Brazilian Portuguese:
TOP LEFT 'ACESSO À CENTRAL': login split composition with spectacular vertical city of Oa / green power battery image left, clean login form right. Heading 'Sua vontade. Seu acesso.' Fields 'E-mail' and 'Senha', primary 'Entrar', link 'Voltar ao portal'. A ceremonial emblem crowns the image.
TOP MIDDLE 'LANTERNAS DA TROPA': public catalog, top navigation Início, Lanternas, Sobre, Entrar. Bold title 'Lanternas da Tropa', filter 'Todos os setores', 3 horizontal personnel rows with distinct circular monograms HJ, JS, KC; names Hal Jordan, John Stewart, Kilowog; sector 2814 / 674 and 'Ver ficha'. Cinematic wide galactic image as header, readable solid dark list area.
TOP RIGHT 'FICHA DO LANTERNA': public profile of 'John Stewart', abstract green holographic insignia illustration on left, readable info right: 'Setor 2814', 'Tropa dos Lanternas Verdes', short biography 'Disciplina e determinação a serviço do universo.' and action 'Voltar aos lanternas'. No photo or face.
BOTTOM LEFT 'OCORRÊNCIAS': private app with narrow OANET sidebar: Visão geral, Ocorrências, Lanternas. Header 'Ocorrências', primary 'Registrar ocorrência', compact filter toolbar Status / Gravidade / Setor, 3 readable incident rows: Distúrbio em Coast City / Setor 2814 / Alta / Em atendimento; Sinal desconhecido / Setor 2814 / Média / Aberta; Patrulha em Korugar / Setor 1417 / Baixa / Resolvida. Text and icon status, no colored left stripes.
BOTTOM MIDDLE 'REGISTRAR OCORRÊNCIA': private app clean generously sized form on near-black emerald solid surface with labels 'Título', 'Descrição', 'Setor', 'Gravidade', buttons 'Cancelar', 'Registrar ocorrência'. Very narrow cinematic Oa image to right; precise standard controls with emerald focus outline. No invented complex fields.
BOTTOM RIGHT 'ATRIBUIR RESPONSÁVEL': private app heading 'Atribuir responsável', context 'Distúrbio em Coast City · Setor 2814', 3 selectable radio rows 'Hal Jordan', 'John Stewart', 'Guy Gardner', each monogram, then primary 'Confirmar atribuição' and secondary 'Cancelar'. Real form affordances; cinematic green insignia detail.

Preserve consistency across all six screens. Green cinematic movie terminal rather than ordinary corporate dashboard; art and illuminated edges feel physically present. Screenshot proportions can adapt to fit board, clearly distinguish six pages. Add small footer in board margin 'OANET · Estudos visuais · Dados ilustrativos'. Output excellent art direction, not a collage of stock templates. No watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ultra-wide cinematic website background, landscape 16:9. Original cinematic Green Lantern Corps / OANET visual identity. High-budget science fiction film production design, physically rendered alien materials, near-black emerald shadows, brilliant green willpower energy, restrained pale gold architectural details, no purple, deep space, finely controlled emissive bloom, detailed and convincing, no watermarks. Primary request: breathtaking establishing shot of the capital of Oa and the Green Lantern Central Power Battery. View from a monumental terrace above cloud level into an immense ancient alien city of slender angular towers, an immense circular ring-shaped power battery structure to the RIGHT of the composition holds a luminous green energy core and projects a column into the atmosphere. Planet with visible curvature and moons behind. Deep perspective, small distant patrol craft for scale, no foreground people. The LEFT 42 percent is dark quiet atmospheric space and a faint planetary horizon, intentionally free of buildings and bright objects so a separate HTML heading can later overlay it. RIGHT 58 percent holds the architecture and dramatic cinematic green energy. Panorama spreads continuously across full frame; no artificial division or embedded frame. Beautiful contrast and tactile aged metallic stone, dignified rather than busy. NO text, labels, typography, interface, buttons, border or dashboard. This is a standalone finished environment asset, not a screenshot.

High-budget science fiction film production design, physically rendered alien materials, near-black emerald shadows, brilliant green willpower energy, restrained pale gold architectural details, no purple, deep space, finely controlled emissive bloom, detailed and convincing, no watermarks. Smooth tailored black and deep emerald armored uniform, visible authentic Green Lantern insignia centered on chest; emerald energy eye mask with realistic eye openings and faint green reflections; NOT a face-covering helmet and NOT a recreation of a particular actor or named existing hero.
